items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And then she got hold of Aretha Franklin. But Aretha Franklin was kind of... She was on liquor; she drank too much.

ctx.x: All you have to do is give them a contract and they'd have signed it, wouldn't they?

Yeah, they would have signed it. But she didn't have that knowledge. She just believed in freelancing and booking whoever she could. And then she got hold of Aretha Franklin. But Aretha Franklin was kind of... She was on liquor; she drank too much.
What I'm trying to find out from you, since you're in the business, and this is for posterity... I'm talking from... This turns now into a Black entity.
